title: Bug Catcher 3D
description: Spot and snatch mischievous crawling bugs darting across vibrant 3D scenes—chain fast reflexes and clear every wave before the clock expires.
controls: Tap swiftly on scurrying bugs to catch them and hit each stage's target score before time runs out.

zh-CN.title: 抓虫子 3D
zh-CN.description: 魔性手速解压抓虫子 3D：眼疾手快精准捕捉满屏乱窜的搞笑小虫子，连击加分超上头，专治手残！
zh-CN.controls: 眼疾手快点击屏幕中四处乱窜的小虫子进行捕捉，达成目标分数即可过关。
